newsitem.title: USA: Florida Power nuclear plant resumes normal opers.
newsitem.headline: Florida Power nuclear plant resumes normal opers.

text.p: Florida Power Corp, a unit of Florida Progress Corp, said Saturday its Crystal River 3 nuclear unit returned to normal conditions.
The unit had been in an "unusual event" status since September 19 after mechanics discovered a coin lodged in a lube-oil strainer associated with the "A" emergency diesel generator.
Investigations into the coin discovery are continuing.
The plant has been off-line since September 2 because of unrelated repairs to the main turbine and the "A" emergency diesel generator was out of service at the time for maintenance.
